description: In ONE call, switch chosen series of a project's calendar off for a period — kind 'pause', e.g. every class of the week of run-throughs: name the events by 'events' (eventIds), 'externalIds' or a 'label' they carry — or mark DAYS OFF — kind 'dayoff', a holiday: no occurrence of any repeating event lands on it. Only the days 'from'..'to' (inclusive, at most 366) are touched; other weeks are not. Nothing is rewritten: lifting it with delete_calendar_pause brings the occurrences back, except one somebody changed by hand after the pause began, which keeps that change. Answers the pause and 'affected', how many occurrences it takes off. Anybody who may write in the project.

externalIds.description: A pause's events by their external ids, 'a,b'.

label.description: A pause takes every event with this label.

to.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD; default the first.

name: set_calendar_pause
title: Set calendar pause
